title: Sage terrain record
description: A terrain record (TerrainRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another terrain record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

generator.description: The built-in generator: Flat (a plane) or Hills (smooth noise) (TerrainGeneratorKind, default "Flat")

seed.description: What the hills are made from; the same seed is the same ground. (int, default 0)

height.description: The height of flat ground, and the middle of the hills. Unit: m. (float, default 0)

amplitude.description: How far hills rise above, and fall below, `height`. Unit: m. Range: 0 to 1000. (float, default 20)

wavelength.description: How far apart the hills are. Unit: m. Range: 8 to 100000. (float, default 256)

surfaces.description: What the ground is made of, by terrain layer: the first is everywhere a generator paints nothing else. Names a physics_material record. (List<RecordId>)

surfaces+.description: Adds to "surfaces": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

surfaces-.description: Removes these from "surfaces" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

material.description: What the ground is drawn with: layers blended by height and slope. Empty: one tiling texture. Names a terrain_material record. (RecordId)

sculpt.description: The editor's sculpt and paint over the generator (a .sterrain file). Empty: terrain/<id>.sterrain, if there is one. A terrain_sculpt path. (AssetPath)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
